description: Ayagama Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and Noarrow Lanes - 2nd Gazette.
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically the confirmation of possession of roads and narrow lanes to the Ayagama Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules with land coordinates, road names, and measurements, which falls under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership, and land development matters.
